list.name: base
list.label: Base
list.description: The version everything is compared with; by default the newest commit CI benchmarked on main. Labels: commit · first benchmarked · CI target (main or pull request), and whether it is the newest commit CI benchmarked for that target.
list.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT version, first_run, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY first_run) AS i
  FROM (SELECT backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END AS version, min(started_at) AS first_run
        FROM helium_runs
        WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})) AND (${builds:raw} OR NOT coalesce(dirty, false))
    AND status <> 'SKIPPED' AND backend_version IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY 1) x
),
tg AS (
  -- CI target of a commit (main wins over a PR); latest: the newest benchmarked commit of that target
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (helium_commit) helium_commit AS version, pr_number,
         CASE WHEN pr_number IS NULL THEN 'main' ELSE 'PR #' || pr_number END AS target,
         updated_at = max(updated_at) OVER (PARTITION BY pr_number) AS latest
  FROM bench_targets
  ORDER BY helium_commit, pr_number NULLS FIRST
),
vl AS (
  SELECT v.*, tg.pr_number, tg.target, tg.latest,
         to_char(v.first_run, 'MM-DD') || ' ' || left(v.version, 8)
           || CASE WHEN v.version LIKE '%+dirty' THEN ' dirty' ELSE '' END || coalesce(' ' || tg.target, '') AS label
  FROM v LEFT JOIN tg USING (version)
)
SELECT '__main' AS __value, 'newest main commit' AS __text, NULL::bigint AS i
UNION ALL
SELECT version, left(version, 8) || CASE WHEN version LIKE '%+dirty' THEN ' dirty' ELSE '' END
         || ' · ' || to_char(first_run, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
         || ' · ' || coalesce(target || CASE WHEN latest THEN ', newest benchmarked' ELSE ', older commit' END, 'not a CI run'), i FROM vl
ORDER BY i DESC NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Commits
panels.description: The selected Helium commits. CI target and 'Newest benchmarked' come from bench_targets (which commits CI keeps): whether this is the newest commit CI benchmarked for main or for its pull request. Branch, pull request and 'Newest commit of' come live from GitHub (viperproject/helium): 'Newest commit of' lists the branches whose current head is this commit, so an empty cell means the branch has moved on (or was deleted). GitHub allows 60 unauthenticated requests per hour; see grafana/provisioning/datasources/github.yaml for a token. Click a commit to open it on GitHub.

targets.root_selector: . as $b | [${commits:doublequote}] | map(split(":") as [$v, $t] | ($v | sub("\\+dirty$"; "")) as $c | {commit: $v, newest: ([$b[] | select(.commit.sha == $c) | .name] | if length > 0 then join(", ") else null end)})

. as $p | [${commits:doublequote}] | map(split(":") as [$v, $t] | (first($p[] | select((.number | tostring) == $t)) // {}) as $pr | {commit: $v, branch: (if $t == "main" then "main" else $pr.head.ref end), pr: $pr.title, state: (if $pr.merged_at then "merged" else $pr.state end)})

panels.title: Versions
panels.description: Coverage and soundness of every selected version, compared with the base. Silicon's verdict per file is its most recent VERIFIED/FAILED run of that file, from any suite. Unsound: Helium VERIFIED where Silicon FAILED. Incomplete: Helium FAILED where Silicon VERIFIED.

panels.title: Versions
panels.description: One row per selected version, base first. Judged by Silicon: files Helium decided and Silicon decided too, so they can be classed as agree / unsound / incomplete. The 'vs base' columns compare each file with the base (files both ran): +new became unsound / incomplete / decided, −fixed / −lost stopped being so. Files are identified by content (vpr_sha256), so an edited benchmark counts as a new file. A file counts as decided when Helium returned VERIFIED or FAILED. Silicon's verdict per file is its most recent VERIFIED/FAILED run of that file, from any suite. Unsound: Helium VERIFIED where Silicon FAILED. Incomplete: Helium FAILED where Silicon VERIFIED.

sel AS (

  SELECT vl.*, vl.version = b.version AS is_base, CASE WHEN vl.version = b.version THEN 0 ELSE vl.i END AS o
  FROM vl, b
  WHERE vl.version = b.version OR '__all' IN (${heads:sqlstring}) OR vl.version IN (${heads:sqlstring})
),
h AS (
  -- one row per selected version and file (by content); t: median ${metric:text} over the iterations
  SELECT backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END AS version,
         vpr_sha256,
         min(suite || '/' || coalesce(family || '/', '') || test) AS file,
         max(status) AS status,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ${metric:raw}) AS t,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_s) AS wall
  FROM helium_runs
  WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})) AND (${builds:raw} OR NOT coalesce(dirty, false))
    AND status <> 'SKIPPED' AND backend_version IS NOT NULL
    AND backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END IN (SELECT version FROM sel)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
s AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) vpr_sha256, status, wall FROM (
    SELECT run_id, vpr_sha256, max(started_at) AS started, max(status) AS status,
           percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_s) AS wall
    FROM silicon_runs WHERE status <> 'SKIPPED' GROUP BY 1, 2) r
  -- latest verdict; files Silicon never decided keep their latest outcome instead
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') DESC, started DESC
),
c AS (
  SELECT h.*, sel.i, sel.o, sel.label, sel.is_base, s.status AS s_status, s.wall AS s_wall,
         h.status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') AS decided,
         CASE WHEN h.status NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') THEN 'undecided'
              WHEN s.status IS NULL THEN 'silicon not run'
              WHEN s.status = 'TIMED_OUT' THEN 'silicon timed out'
              WHEN s.status = 'CRASHED' THEN 'silicon crashed'
              WHEN s.status = 'INCONCLUSIVE' THEN 'silicon inconclusive'
              WHEN h.status = s.status THEN 'agree'
              WHEN h.status = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'unsound'
              ELSE 'incomplete' END AS class
  FROM h JOIN sel USING (version) LEFT JOIN s USING (vpr_sha256)
),
cb AS (SELECT * FROM c WHERE is_base),
per AS (
  SELECT version, o, label, is_base,
         count(*) AS files,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'VERIFIED') AS verified,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed,

WITH v AS (
  SELECT version, first_run, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY first_run) AS i
  FROM (SELECT backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END AS version, min(started_at) AS first_run
        FROM helium_runs
        WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})) AND (${builds:raw} OR NOT coalesce(dirty, false))
    AND status <> 'SKIPPED' AND backend_version IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY 1) x
),
tg AS (
  -- CI target of a commit (main wins over a PR); latest: the newest benchmarked commit of that target
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (helium_commit) helium_commit AS version, pr_number,
         CASE WHEN pr_number IS NULL THEN 'main' ELSE 'PR #' || pr_number END AS target,
         updated_at = max(updated_at) OVER (PARTITION BY pr_number) AS latest
  FROM bench_targets
  ORDER BY helium_commit, pr_number NULLS FIRST
),
vl AS (
  SELECT v.*, tg.pr_number, tg.target, tg.latest,
         to_char(v.first_run, 'MM-DD') || ' ' || left(v.version, 8)
           || CASE WHEN v.version LIKE '%+dirty' THEN ' dirty' ELSE '' END || coalesce(' ' || tg.target, '') AS label
  FROM v LEFT JOIN tg USING (version)
),
b AS (
  -- base: the picked version, else the newest main commit, else the oldest version
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT version FROM vl WHERE version = ${base:sqlstring}),
                  (SELECT version FROM vl WHERE target = 'main' ORDER BY i DESC LIMIT 1),
                  (SELECT version FROM vl ORDER BY i LIMIT 1)) AS version
),
sel AS (
  -- base first, then the heads oldest first
  SELECT vl.*, vl.version = b.version AS is_base, CASE WHEN vl.version = b.version THEN 0 ELSE vl.i END AS o
  FROM vl, b
  WHERE vl.version = b.version OR '__all' IN (${heads:sqlstring}) OR vl.version IN (${heads:sqlstring})
),
h AS (
  -- one row per selected version and file (by content); t: median ${metric:text} over the iterations
  SELECT backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END AS version,
         vpr_sha256,
         min(suite || '/' || coalesce(family || '/', '') || test) AS file,
         max(status) AS status,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ${metric:raw}) AS t,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_s) AS wall
  FROM helium_runs
  WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})) AND (${builds:raw} OR NOT coalesce(dirty, false))
    AND status <> 'SKIPPED' AND backend_version IS NOT NULL
    AND backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END IN (SELECT version FROM sel)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
s AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) vpr_sha256, status, wall FROM (
    SELECT run_id, vpr_sha256, max(started_at) AS started, max(status) AS status,
           percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_s) AS wall
    FROM silicon_runs WHERE status <> 'SKIPPED' GROUP BY 1, 2) r
  -- latest verdict; files Silicon never decided keep their latest outcome instead
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') DESC, started DESC
),
c AS (
  SELECT h.*, sel.i, sel.o, sel.label, sel.is_base, s.status AS s_status, s.wall AS s_wall,
         h.status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') AS decided,
         CASE WHEN h.status NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') THEN 'undecided'
              WHEN s.status IS NULL THEN 'silicon not run'
              WHEN s.status = 'TIMED_OUT' THEN 'silicon timed out'
              WHEN s.status = 'CRASHED' THEN 'silicon crashed'
              WHEN s.status = 'INCONCLUSIVE' THEN 'silicon inconclusive'
              WHEN h.status = s.status THEN 'agree'
              WHEN h.status = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'unsound'
              ELSE 'incomplete' END AS class
  FROM h JOIN sel USING (version) LEFT JOIN s USING (vpr_sha256)
),
vs AS (
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT version FROM sel WHERE version = ${ver:sqlstring}),
                  (SELECT version FROM sel WHERE NOT is_base ORDER BY i DESC LIMIT 1),
                  (SELECT version FROM sel WHERE is_base)) AS version
),
pair AS (
  -- base against the picked version, per file
  SELECT vpr_sha256, coalesce(hd.file, bs.file) AS file,
         bs.status AS b_status, hd.status AS h_status, bs.t AS b_t, hd.t AS h_t,
         bs.class AS b_class, hd.class AS h_class, coalesce(bs.decided, false) AS b_dec,
         coalesce(hd.decided, false) AS h_dec
  FROM (SELECT * FROM c WHERE is_base) bs
  FULL JOIN (SELECT c.* FROM c JOIN vs USING (version)) hd USING (vpr_sha256)
),
labelled AS (
  SELECT pair.*, CASE
           WHEN b_status IS NULL THEN 'only in version'
           WHEN h_status IS NULL THEN 'only in base'
           WHEN h_class = 'unsound' AND b_class <> 'unsound' THEN 'became unsound'
           WHEN h_class = 'incomplete' AND b_class <> 'incomplete' THEN 'became incomplete'
           WHEN h_status = 'TIMED_OUT' AND b_status <> 'TIMED_OUT' THEN 'now times out'
           WHEN h_status = 'CRASHED' AND b_status <> 'CRASHED' THEN 'now crashes'
           WHEN b_dec AND NOT h_dec THEN 'no longer decided'
           WHEN h_dec AND NOT b_dec THEN 'newly decided'
           WHEN b_class = 'unsound' AND h_class <> 'unsound' THEN 'fixed unsound'
           WHEN b_class = 'incomplete' AND h_class <> 'incomplete' THEN 'fixed incomplete'
           WHEN b_status <> h_status THEN 'verdict flip'
           WHEN b_class IS DISTINCT FROM h_class THEN 'class changed'
           WHEN NOT h_dec THEN 'still undecided'
           WHEN h_t < b_t / 1.1 THEN 'faster'
           WHEN h_t > b_t * 1.1 THEN 'slower'
           ELSE 'same' END AS change,
         CASE WHEN b_dec AND h_dec AND h_t > 0 THEN b_t / h_t END AS ratio
  FROM pair
)
SELECT change AS "Change", 'details ›' AS "Details", file AS "File", b_status AS "Base", h_status AS "Version",
       b_t AS "Base ${metric:text}", h_t AS "Version ${metric:text}", ratio AS "×",
       b_class AS "Base vs Silicon", h_class AS "Version vs Silicon",
       vpr_sha256 AS sha, (SELECT version FROM b) AS bver, (SELECT version FROM vs) AS hver
FROM labelled
ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['became unsound', 'became incomplete', 'now times out', 'now crashes', 'no longer decided', 'newly decided', 'fixed unsound', 'fixed incomplete', 'verdict flip', 'class changed', 'slower', 'faster', 'same', 'still undecided', 'only in version', 'only in base'], change),
         ratio, file
